new_series.title: Time
new_series.synopsis: New chaplain Marie-Louise arrives at HMYOI Alderwick and clashes with veteran officer Bailey. Meanwhile, young offenders struggle through the first weeks of their incarceration.

new_series.title: Later... with Jools Holland
new_series.synopsis: Jools is joined by Paul Heaton, Skye Newman, DC3, mary in the junkyard and Dermot Henry, and chats to Johnny Marr.

new_series.title: Krapopolis
new_series.synopsis: Three siblings attempt to run the first city free of godly influence in ancient Greece, which is complicated by a run-in with cannibal neighbours and their goddess mother demanding her own temple.

new_series.title: Artworks
new_series.synopsis: John Wilson explores the story of the guitar as a driver of social and cultural change powering counter-culture in the 20th century. Where does its extraordinary legacy stand now?

new_series.title: Sideways
new_series.synopsis: Matthew Syed asks what it means to be distracted in a media world vying for our attention. First, he seeks answers in the works of Aldous Huxley and media theorist Neil Postman.

new_series.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home
new_series.synopsis: Irish chef and author Clodagh McKenna demonstrates the recipes that she loves to cook, beginning with four of her favourite one-pan dishes . She makes broccoli salmon noodles and an all-in-one spicy sausage pasta, and shares the tricks to make her pear, thyme and brie tart. She then picks greens from the garden to go in a big warming pot of walled garden soup that she makes in her pickling shed to share with her husband Harry Herbert.
